description: Strength for Today, Year 3. Scripture-grounded doctrinal revision drafts; not independently edited or approved for publication.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Hope Rooted in God
entries.reflection: Encouragement rooted in God's Word does not deny hardship; it reminds us where help is found. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this within your family.
entries.prayer: Father, help me serve without seeking praise within your family; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Seek God sincerely before asking Him to change the people around you. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my heart humble before You when you are asked for advice; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God calls believers to be holy because He is holy; holiness belongs in speech, thoughts, and conduct. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this while caring for another person.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me in truth and holiness while caring for another person; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Encouragement rooted in God's Word does not deny hardship; it reminds us where help is found. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this within your family.
topics.prayer: Father, help me serve without seeking praise within your family; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Persevering in prayer is not a way to control God; it is faithful trust in His wisdom. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this during a demanding day.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to trust Your wisdom during a demanding day; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Confession without willingness to forsake known sin is not a substitute for repentance. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when someone needs help.
topics.prayer: Father, make me faithful in small duties when someone needs help; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Make decisions prayerfully and test your desires against Scripture. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when you are tempted to respond sharply.
topics.prayer: Father, help me speak with grace when you are tempted to respond sharply; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit strengthens believers to pray, obey, and serve others. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this in a moment of uncertainty.
topics.prayer: Father, help me receive Your correction in a moment of uncertainty; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ sends His followers to proclaim the gospel with truthfulness, urgency, and compassion. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this in your work or studies.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to act faithfully in your work or studies; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Forgiveness and patience are not weakness; they reflect the character of Christ. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when you need to apologise.
topics.prayer: Father, give me grace to obey when you need to apologise; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Read a passage in context before applying it to a difficult decision. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this in a difficult conversation.
topics.prayer: Father, guard me from pride and carelessness in a difficult conversation; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Seek counsel, consider consequences, and pray before deciding. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are misunderstood.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my love for others when you are misunderstood; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: The certainty of God's judgment calls for sober self-examination and gospel witness. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when a promise becomes costly.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my commitment to Your Word when a promise becomes costly; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — The Call to Prayer
entries.reflection: Do not let public prayer replace secret devotion and obedient living. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when disappointment arises.
entries.prayer: Father, help me receive Your correction when disappointment arises; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this in a difficult conversation.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to trust Your wisdom in a difficult conversation; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Sanctification is God's gracious work, not an excuse for careless living or self-righteousness. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when you are misunderstood.
topics.prayer: Father, make me faithful in small duties when you are misunderstood; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: When answers delay, continue to pray and fulfil the responsibilities before you. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this when a promise becomes costly.
topics.prayer: Father, help me speak with grace when a promise becomes costly; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Do not let public prayer replace secret devotion and obedient living. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when disappointment arises.
topics.prayer: Father, help me receive Your correction when disappointment arises; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ's death and resurrection are central to the gospel, not our personal achievements. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you prepare for worship.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to act faithfully as you prepare for worship; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust the Lord enough to tell the truth even when deception looks convenient. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you encounter criticism.
topics.prayer: Father, give me grace to obey when you encounter criticism; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness for Christ and glorify Him. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when it is easier to keep silent.
topics.prayer: Father, guard me from pride and carelessness when it is easier to keep silent; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The aim of evangelism is to point people to Christ, not to win an argument. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when plans change.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my love for others when plans change; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Do not spread a rumour when you could seek understanding and peace. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you make a private decision.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my commitment to Your Word as you make a private decision; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Obey what Scripture teaches even when no one is watching. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this as you consider your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my heart humble before You as you consider your priorities; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom listens carefully and resists hasty judgment. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you examine your conscience.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me in truth and holiness as you examine your conscience; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Encourage believers to remain steadfast rather than stirring fear with speculation. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, help me serve without seeking praise when you are asked for advice; keep me steadfast in Christ. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Religious activity cannot replace the new birth and sincere faith in Christ. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this in your work or studies.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
